definitions.gloss: to fulfill; to grant; to make come true
definitions.explanation: To make a wish, dream, or hope become reality. Can describe both fulfilling one's own dreams and granting someone else's wishes.

examples.english: I want to make my dream come true.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{長年|ながねん}の{願|ねが}いを{叶|かな}えた。
{子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}からの{夢|ゆめ}を{叶|かな}えるために、{毎日|まいにち}{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けてきた。
examples.english: I have continued to work hard every day in order to fulfill my childhood dream.

notes:
The intransitive counterpart is {叶|かな}う (to come true, to be fulfilled). {叶|かな}える is transitive — the subject actively makes the dream or wish come true. Very common in inspirational and motivational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{夢|ゆめ}を{叶|かな}える: to make a dream come true
・{願|ねが}いを{叶|かな}える: to grant a wish
・{望|のぞ}みを{叶|かな}える: to fulfill a desire
